question: Compare my branches
headline: Demo Restaurant – Kasarani spends 37% of every sale on ingredients; Demo Restaurant spends 29.2%. That is 7.8 points more, about KES 33,278 a month at Demo Restaurant – Kasarani's sales.

rows.label: Out of every KES 100, ingredients
rows.note: Demo Restaurant – Kasarani (the higher); Demo Restaurant 29.2%

rows.label: Difference
rows.note: Demo Restaurant – Kasarani spends more of each sale on ingredients

rows.note: 7.8% of its last 30 days of sales (KES 426,640)

assumptions.text: Both are the last 30 days, worked out the same way as on each branch's Home.
The monthly figure is an estimate: it assumes Demo Restaurant – Kasarani could spend what Demo Restaurant spends and sell the same.
